title: Prepare typed contract fields
responsibility: Prepares typed contract fields and per-callable parameter and return contracts with honest examples.

inputs.name: typeLabel.type
inputs.description: A public type expression that may contain an inferred module import.

inputs.name: contractFields.unit
inputs.description: The entity whose contract fields and declared JSON examples will be displayed.

inputs.name: contractFields.category
inputs.description: The entity category; configs call their outputs Provides.

inputs.name: contractFacts.rows
inputs.description: Prepared readable contract rows, including facts beyond individual fields.

inputs.name: contractFacts.unit
inputs.description: The entity whose execution targets may be listed as contract facts.

inputs.name: contractFacts.category
inputs.description: The entity category; functions also expose execution targets.

inputs.name: callableContracts.unit
inputs.description: Source-derived callable metadata and declared examples at the selected revision.

outputs.name: typeLabel
outputs.description: The type expression with inferred import paths removed.

outputs.name: contractFields
outputs.description: Input, output and error groups with descriptions and declared examples. Safe simple types may get labelled placeholders; opaque types keep explicit gaps.

outputs.name: contractFacts
outputs.description: Whole-contract facts without duplicate field summaries, plus execution targets for functions.

outputs.name: callableContracts
outputs.type: { name: string; signature: string; groups: ContractGroup[] }[]
outputs.description: Each callable with its literal parameter names and its own return type and examples.
